For a $d^2$ ion in an octahedral field, the ground state is $^3T_{1g}(F)$, and the spin-allowed transitions are to the $^3T_{2g}$, $^3T_{1g}(P)$, and $^3A_{2g}$ states.

$$Dq = 1,403.3\text{ cm}^{-1}$$

$$B = \frac{32,330}{21.55} \approx 1,500\text{ cm}^{-1}$$

$Dq \approx 1,403\text{ cm}^{-1}$
$B \approx 1,500\text{ cm}^{-1}$
